question: Odacchi, hello!! On P. 145 of Chapter 866 (Volume 86), during the scene showing Hajrudin’s early childhood, there is a boy eating snacks behind him. Is this the same giant that appears on P.184 of Ch. 500, “Pirate Stansen”? Macaron
answer: Good eye. You’re right, he’s Hajrudin’s childhood friend. In a very roundabout way, the man on the left (adult version) somehow ended up working under Luffy’s Straw Hat Grand Fleet.
